transitions.fromZh: 风钟海岸：玩家尚未触碰带钟的风刻痕
transitions.fromEn: Windbell Coast: the player has not touched the Bell-Bearing Wind mark
transitions.toZh: 玩家触碰刻痕，确认风携余温却不让钟声清晰
transitions.toEn: The player touches the mark and acknowledges that the wind carries warmth but not a clear bell
transitions.narrativeZh: 刻痕被触碰；风仍不响，余温仍在。
transitions.narrativeEn: The mark is touched; the wind stays silent, and its warmth remains.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 海风掠过刻痕，没有留下可辨的钟声。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The sea wind passes the mark without leaving a distinct bell sound.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 带钟的风：触碰后仍听不清
transitions.atlasHookEn: Bell-bearing wind: still unclear after the touch

transitions.fromZh: 风钟海岸：玩家尚未触碰盐结小龛刻痕
transitions.fromEn: Windbell Coast: the player has not touched the Salt Shrine mark
transitions.toZh: 玩家触碰刻痕，见证盐龛被海抹去又重写
transitions.toEn: The player touches the mark and witnesses the sea erase and rewrite the salt shrine
transitions.narrativeZh: 盐龛仍由海每日抹去、每日重写；玩家记下这次见证。
transitions.narrativeEn: The sea still erases and rewrites the shrine each day; the player records having witnessed it.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 海水退去又回来，盐龛没有要求留下。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The tide recedes and returns; the shrine asks nothing to be kept.

transitions.fromZh: 风钟海岸：玩家尚未触碰防波堤潮痕刻痕
transitions.fromEn: Windbell Coast: the player has not touched the Tide-Lines mark
transitions.toZh: 玩家触碰刻痕，辨认潮痕是被海反复擦写的歌
transitions.toEn: The player touches the mark and recognizes the tide-lines as a song repeatedly erased and rewritten by the sea
transitions.narrativeZh: 潮痕仍会被海擦写；玩家不把它们当作固定谱句。
transitions.narrativeEn: The sea keeps rewriting the tide-lines; the player does not treat them as a fixed score.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 潮水退去，石上的线条没有留下定稿。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The tide recedes, leaving no final version of the lines on stone.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 防波堤潮痕：一首未定稿的歌
transitions.atlasHookEn: Tide-lines: a song without a final draft
canonEvidence: 世界谱·刻痕「防波堤潮痕」

transitions.fromZh: 风钟海岸：玩家尚未触碰缩住的响石刻痕
transitions.fromEn: Windbell Coast: the player has not touched the Still Press-Stone mark
transitions.toZh: 玩家触碰刻痕，体验按下响石时整片海静止
transitions.toEn: The player touches the mark and experiences the whole sea stilling when the sound-stone is pressed
transitions.narrativeZh: 按下响石，潮声停了一刻；松手后，刻痕仍记着这一停。
transitions.narrativeEn: The surf stops for a moment when the stone is pressed; the mark retains that pause after release.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 海面停住片刻，没有回答，也没有被改变。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The sea holds still briefly; it neither answers nor changes.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 缩住的响石：按下时海静止
transitions.atlasHookEn: Still Press-Stone: the sea holds when pressed
canonEvidence: 世界谱·刻痕「缩住的响石」

atlasDraft.pZh: 潮水退去，船舱里的干痕还在。阿汐把盐放在门槛上，没有带到船边。船没有动。薄簿仍合着。后来潮水回来，盐少了一角，干痕没有变。她没有记下是哪一刻少的。
atlasDraft.pEn: At ebb, the dry mark remained inside the boat. Axi left the salt on the threshold, not aboard. The boat did not move. The ledger stayed closed. When the tide returned, one corner of the salt was gone, but the mark had not changed. She did not record when it happened.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些东西，不必同时抵达。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some things need not arrive together.
